name: InterContinental Cascais-Estoril
positioning: Luxury boutique seaside resort in Estoril facing the Atlantic on Cascais Bay, with sea-view balconies, gardens with an outdoor pool, and the InterContinental Spa by L'Occitane
best_for: Travellers who want an ocean-facing base on Cascais Bay within walking distance of sandy beaches along the seafront promenade
Couples looking for sea views, a spa and a garden pool

facts.text: The InterContinental Cascais Estoril is a luxury boutique hotel facing the Atlantic Ocean.
The hotel is a luxury seaside resort on Cascais Bay.
Rooms and suites have modern design, contemporary decor and views over Cascais Bay.
The hotel has rooms with spacious terraces.
The hotel's spa is the InterContinental Spa by L'Occitane.
The outdoor pool is located in the hotel's gardens.
Bago du Vin Bar & Terrace serves Portuguese and Mediterranean cuisine with fresh ingredients and Atlantic views.
Bago du Vin pairs its dishes with a selection of more than 100 wines.
Couples can hold their wedding at Villa Atlantico, a setting beside the Atlantic Ocean.
The off-site Estoril Golf Club course overlooks Estoril and the sea and is set among eucalyptus, mimosa and fir trees.
Cabo da Roca, featured in the hotel's local guide, is the westernmost point of Europe.

highlights.text: The hotel faces the Atlantic Ocean as a luxury seaside resort on Cascais Bay.
The hotel is a gentle walk along the seafront promenade from the sandy beaches of Cascais Bay.
The hotel has a lush garden, and guests can take in the sea view from a private balcony.
The InterContinental Spa by L'Occitane is the hotel's spa.
The indoor pool area includes an indoor pool, a sauna and a steam bath.

considerations.text: The outdoor pool operates from April to October.
The hotel welcomes dogs under 5 kg for a nightly supplement.
WhataHotel notes the hotel is outside Lisbon city center, so exploring the city requires transport.
